notes.title: LLaWB Demo 0.1.2 Patch (+ workaround for stutters)
notes.notes:
[h2]In this update:[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed arm bots and cannons not updating their behaviour based on the totems inside. Embarassing. Sorry for that![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the "dog" cutscene trigger sometimes not working[/p][/*][*][p]Transcoded all videos (should help if all video content was missing)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a speed boost for some puzzles in open environments[/p][/*][/list][h2]Workaround for stutters:[/h2][p]Some people have been encountering stutters/ death triggers firing on scene load, etc.

Please, try [b]disabling[/b] forced [b]Nvidias framerate uncapping. [/b][/p][p]This will force the game to 60 fps. I will be working on fixing this, meanwhile please use the workaround. Sorry again![/p]
